 Dwijendranath Thandar  ....P  Mr. Amal Krishna Samanta .....For the Peti  Mr. Binay Kumar Panda  Mr. Arka Chakraborty .....For the Stat  1.
Heard learned Advocates for the parties.
2. Petitioner is the husband of the victim lady.
Allegations against him are general and omnibus.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
There is no chance of abscondence of the petitioner.
Hence, we are of the view further detention of the petitioner is not necessary and he may be granted bail.

4. Accordingly, the petitioner, namely, Dijendranath Thandar @ Dwijendranath Thandar shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Purba Medinipur at Tamluk, subject to Signed By :
APURBA BANDYOPADHYAY High Court of Calcutta 13 th of September 2024 07:45:28 PM condition that he shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever or commit similar offences in future.
